question: By which year is India aiming to end tuberculosis (TB) under the national TB control initiatives?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2025.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 100-day TB campaign aims to end tuberculosis in India by 2025.**
 
• Manipur Governor Bhalla reviewed NIK-SHAY and TB Control initiatives in the state, emphasizing technology-driven measures and broad community engagement.
 
• The State Health Minister provided updates on the Pradhan Mantri TB Mukht Bharat Abhiyan, reinforcing the 2025 target.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **India has set a goal to eliminate TB by 2025 under its national TB control initiatives.**
 
• NIK-SHAY is a TB patient management system used to track and provide support for those affected.
 
• The campaign involves increasing patient support, improving diagnosis, and introducing new treatment protocols.
 
• Mass community participation is considered crucial to meet the 2025 eradication target.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Pradhan Mantri TB Mukht Bharat Abhiyan__

 __
 
• An initiative aiming to eradicate TB in India by strengthening the healthcare system, ensuring availability of medicines, and providing nutritional support to TB patients.
 
• Encourages partnerships between government and private entities for enhanced TB surveillance and treatment coverage.
 
 
 
• NIK-SHAY__
 
 
• A digital platform used to track TB patients, ensuring they receive timely treatment and support.
 
• Facilitates data collection and monitoring, helping the government plan and execute TB control strategies effectively.
